reason: I want to know the film is genuine and the warranty will be honoured, and a site that is only now adding its first partners has no track record yet. Holding the money until the work is done helps, but I still would not pay through an app I have never used, and I would rather see the installer's work before I pay anyone.
objection: Who actually stands behind this? If the film peels or the installer disappears, is the warranty in my account worth anything, and what happens to my money when the shop I was sent to is one nobody I know has ever used?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing verified partners with real reviews from people in my own city, and a named warranty provider I can call directly if the film fails.
